name: Hanime1
notes: Test25 keeps the device-verified Test24 avatar/runtime chain, removes the temporary avatar diagnostic UI, and optimizes comment reply opening. Replies now perform one /loadReplies request that parses content and XPath avatars together instead of the previous data request plus a second avatar request. Comment/reply pages also use the locally persisted active account for button state instead of calling profile() on every page open, removing extra account HTTP requests. A 45-second per-thread reply cache makes immediate reopen fast and is invalidated after posting a reply.
